title: Bedtime matters, not just sleep length
summary: A short note on why a steady bedtime can be as important as total sleep hours.
action_tip: Tonight, choose a realistic bedtime cue and start winding down 30 minutes before it.

title: Protect a consistent sleep window
summary: A regular sleep schedule and enough time in bed make sleep patterns easier to stabilize.
action_tip: Pick one realistic bedtime cue and protect your wake time for one week.

title: 科学去黑头与一周护肤计划（水杨酸、A酸与屏障修护）
summary: 兼顾去黑头、细化毛孔与屏障修护的一周循环护肤法，含通用排期、操作细节、应急刹车与推荐单品。
action_tip: 谨记白天防晒、夜晚分天使用水杨酸与A酸，避免同一晚叠加，做好神经酰胺修护。

title: Build balanced plates
summary: Protein, fiber-rich carbohydrates, fruits or vegetables, healthy fats, and hydration are a practical foundation.
action_tip: At one meal today, add one protein source and one colorful plant food.

title: Use recovery-aware movement
summary: A sustainable routine can mix cardio, strength, and mobility while adjusting to fatigue.
action_tip: If energy is low, keep the habit with a shorter stretch, walk, or light strength set.

title: Make recovery small and repeatable
summary: Short meditation, gratitude, prayer, and social connection can make recovery easier to practice.
action_tip: Do a two-minute reset: breathe, stretch, pray, write one thanks, or message one supportive person.
